template: Goal / Context / Acceptance criteria / Scope & non-goals / Execution hints.
rules: Keep the task bounded: one file set, one spec, one verifiable gate - Flash is the fast lane (~200 tok/s) for mechanical execution, not open-ended exploration.
State the acceptance gate verbatim so the run can be verified in a single pass.
Name exact file paths and identifiers; Flash does less implicit repo-wide inference than SWE-2.
Route open-ended architecture, dead-end debugging, or multi-hop judgment to SWE-2 Max instead - say so in out_scope when the draft is for Flash.
do: Batch mechanical volume (renames, sweeps, triage, translations of spec to code) into a single bounded spec.
Provide the target snippet or convention to mimic; short cycles reward concrete anchors.
State effort explicitly - swe-2-flash-medium for mechanical volume, swe-2-flash-high for bounded technical work.
dont: Do not give Flash ambiguous, multi-objective, or research-shaped goals - that is SWE-2 Max territory.
Do not rely on the executor discovering unstated context across the repo.
Do not bury checkpoints - the bounded contract is what keeps the fast lane fast.
